rows.mechanism: Falling shareholder count between consecutive reports = chips concentrating into fewer hands (informed accumulation, retail exit). Long the quintile with the largest QoQ decline. score = -(HOLDER_NUM / PRE_HOLDER_NUM - 1) from the latest announced report.
rows.reopen: New contract only. Do not retune.

rows.mechanism: Persistent concentration over two reports. Long the quintile with the largest decline vs the report two periods back. score = -(HOLDER_NUM_t / HOLDER_NUM_{t-2} - 1).
rows.reopen: New contract only. Do not retune.

rows.mechanism: Fewer holders per A-share outstanding = concentrated ownership level. Long the quintile with the lowest holders/share. score = -(HOLDER_NUM / TOTAL_A_SHARES).
rows.reopen: New contract only. Do not retune.
